title: Land Cost Per Acre Calculator
description: Work out price per acre from total price and acreage with the Land Cost Per Acre Calculator — the number land buyers actually negotiate in. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a $250,000 parcel of 5 acres prices at $50,000 per acre — the figure that lets you compare it fairly with the 40-acre listing down the road at $8,500 per acre.
quick_answer: The Land Cost Per Acre Calculator divides a parcel's total price by its acreage to give the cost per acre — the unit price land is compared, listed and negotiated in. Enter the total price and the acres and read the per-acre figure, with per-hectare equivalents alongside.

popular_table.note: 1 acre = 43,560 sq ft = 0.404686 hectares. Per-acre figures exclude buildings and improvements unless the listing says otherwise — land-only comparisons are the honest ones.

faq: Does location really swing per-acre prices this much?

Enormously — development land near a growing suburb can exceed $100,000 per acre while remote agricultural land trades under $3,000. The calculator reports the arithmetic; the market supplies the drama.
Should buildings be included in the price?
For a land comparison, no — a house on the parcel is a separate asset. Listings that bundle them make per-acre figures misleading, which is why agents separate land value when they can.
What if I only know square feet?
Divide square feet by 43,560 for acres, then proceed — or start from the Land Cost Per Square Foot Calculator and convert up. The two pages are the same coin.
They ride with some parcels and not others, and per-acre comparisons silently assume similar rights. A cheap per-acre price with severed mineral rights is a different product, not a bargain.
How do I get acreage for a parcel I am eyeing?
Measure it: draw the boundary in the Map Area Calculator, or take the surveyed figure from the listing documents — and trust the survey over the drawing when they disagree.
Urban land trades by the square foot, where the numbers breathe better. This page still computes per-acre honestly — $1.15 per sq ft wearing its $50,000-per-acre dress.
